arguments.expression: () => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input'); for (const [label, value] of [['Username','bench_user'],['Password','S3cure!pass#42']]) { const el = Array.from(inputs).find(e => e.labels && Array.from(e.labels).some(l => l.textContent.trim() === label)); if (!el) throw new Error('Missing '+label); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(el,value); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); } }
